name: Ihtzi Hurtado
bio:
Ihtzi Hurtado is a Mexican film director, screenwriter, and producer. She gained prominence for directing and writing contemporary Mexican comedy feature films and streaming originals.

Her notable directing and writing credits include the feature films Cosas de hombres (2020) and the Amazon Original movie Locas por el cambio (2020), as well as directing episodes for various television and streaming series.

credits.title: Accidental Partners
credits.overview: Two women discover they were both scammed by the same man (who also got them pregnant). They form an alliance to take revenge.

credits.title: ¿Quieres ser mi novia?
credits.overview: Javi and Lu's relationship faces dangerous territory as old and new temptations emerge: a young woman reigniting Javi's chemistry and a mature man pursuing Lu. Through humor, entanglements, and surprises, their love is tested.

credits.title: ¿Quieres ser mi hijo?
credits.overview: Lu, a conformist woman in her forties, learns that her 15-year partner has been having extramarital affairs. Starting from scratch, she gets involved in an unexpected relationship with a young womanizer.

credits.title: Who's a Good Boy?
credits.overview: Chema has a mission: to date Claudia, the attractive new girl at his school, and lose his virginity. Can he fulfill his dream before graduating?

credits.title: Crazy for Change
credits.overview: Paula and Paulina, two young women who hate each other, magically swap bodies after a high school reunion.
